title: 阿克尚·核心素描
description: 阿克尚回身站在淡描古城前，长白围巾横向展开，金色钩索装备垂于身侧。

art_direction.medium: hand-drawn graphite and charcoal, confident pencil contours, cross-hatching, sculptural chiaroscuro and visible pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Akshan is an adult Shuriman adventurer with warm brown skin, swept dark hair, a short neat beard, lively eyes, and a long pale scarf. Preserve his agile human proportions and ornate golden Sentinel details. His torso is fully covered by a closed cream tunic and short jacket above opaque trousers and boots; his distinctive grappling firearm is carried lowered and inactive.
art_direction.scene: Use a composed near-profile turn, keeping both the recognizable head and essential equipment readable; crisp lit contours contrast with soft charcoal. Build the composition specifically around this champion's defining anatomy, iconic motif and explicitly listed companion, if any. Use one faint environmental cue belonging to this character, and leave the rest as open sketch paper.
art_direction.palette: sand gold, ivory scarf, turquoise, indigo shadow
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing
